title: Trump set to hit India, China, 14 others with new tariffs after probe
description: NEW DELHI: Eight months after it launched a probe on alleged excess industrial capacity in 16 countries, including India, China and the European Union,
author: TNN
content:
NEW DELHI: Eight months after it launched a probe on alleged excess industrial capacity in 16 countries, including India, China and the European Union, the US Trade Representative is all set to unveil its findings in the case and propose tariffs.
The Wall Street Journal said the US is preparing to raise tariffs this week, with Bloomberg reporting that it may come in as early as Tuesday. Indian officials are keeping a close watch on the outcome of the probe, which is likely to be followed by a set of hearings, before final tariffs are announced, in around 45 days.
After the setback in the US Supreme Court over the use of emergency powers to impose "reciprocal tariffs", the Trump administration had launched two probes under Section 301.
Section 301 probe: Govt doesn’t expect any negative impact
While additional tariffs of 10-12.5 per cent were imposed on imports from over 50 countries, including India, for their alleged failure to prohibit the import of goods with forced labour, which harmed American exports, the outcome of the second investigation is awaited.
Going by the mood here, the government does not expect any negative impact, although it maintains that there is no structural excess capacity in India and the surplus is in anticipation of higher demand in the world’s fastest-growing major economy. 
In fact, during deliberations with the US government too, officials have made it clear that the government has not provided subsidy or other support to create capacity, while underlining that any country which has surplus domestic production is engaged in exports.
The report by USTR will be followed by hearings before the final tariff is announced. In the first probe, India had managed to get concessions with the final levy of 10 per cent imposed, against 12.5 per cent, proposed initially. The outcome of the investigation will provide clarity on Trump’s new tariff framework, although the final levy will be known in around 45 days. Based on the final tariff, governments will engage in negotiations for “trade deals”. India is confident of negotiating a deal where its exports enjoy “comparative advantage” over rivals from the region.
While the first set of tariffs related to forced labour have been challenged in US courts, even the second one is expected to face litigation, especially because USTR findings are similar for almost all countries. In the case of structural excess capacity, among the top 20 trading partners for the US, all except Canada, the UK, Brazil and Australia are facing action, with the large European countries being part of the EU. The list also includes Norway, Indonesia, Cambodia and Bangladesh, which are not among the top 20 partners for goods and services trade.

title: Passport has discrepancies in place of birth: CJP's Saurav Das rendered ineligible for foreign travel
description: NEW DELHI: A notice served to CJP activist Saurav Das on Monday evening by the Regional Passport Office (RPO), Chennai, asking him to explain alleged
author: Bharti Jain
content:
Saurav Das, chief spokesperson of the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP), speaks during a press conference in New Delhi, India, November 24, 2026. REUTERS/Bhawika Chhabra
NEW DELHI: A notice served to CJP activist Saurav Das on Monday evening by the Regional Passport Office (RPO), Chennai, asking him to explain alleged discrepancies in his documents relating to place of birth, had rendered his passport ineligible for foreign travel till the response was received and matter resolved.Sources in the govt said the mismatch in birth particulars across different set of documents like aadhaar, passport and birth certificate was flagged in inputs received over the last couple of months, prompting RPO to initiate a fresh verification of documents and information recorded in his passport application file. The passport was issued to him on Aug 21, 2019.While police verification is done either before or after issue of passport (in case of ‘tatkal’ passport), if any adverse or incorrect information comes to light during validity of the passport, a re-verification can be ordered by the RPO by issuing a show-cause notice to the citizen, asking why the passport should not be impounded.A notice was sent to Das by e-mail on Monday evening, asking him to respond within 7 days to the alleged “material suppression of facts” relating to his place of birth. He was asked to clarify the “incorrect” particulars with supporting documents, failing which he could face impounding of his passport under Section 10(b) of the Passports Act, 1967. The notice explicitly advised him not to use his passport till he had filed his response.
“As per rules, if a show-cause notice is issued to the passport holder on why his passport should not be impounded in view of furnishing of incorrect particulars, and a reply is awaited, the respondent cannot travel abroad on that passport till the matter is disposed of,” an officer told TOI. “Das was well-aware that the pending RPO notice would be flagged in the immigration systems, preventing his clearance for boarding the flight to London. Yet, he chose to travel to the airport, possibly so he could play the victim after being stopped at immigration,” said the officer.Das, as per reports, however claims he did not see the email, which landed hours before his flight, till he checked his inbox at the immigration counter.
A govt officer said Das has time till Nov 30 to respond to the RPO notice. “Let him satisfy the RPO as to which set of birth documents must be relied on. Once the RPO clears him in the re-verification exercise, he can resume international travel on the same passport,” said another officer.Sources explained that disparities were flagged only in the recent past in Das’s details like date of birth and father’s name across documents like aadhaar, passport and school certificate, issued from different places of his residence — Delhi and Puducherry. A PIL has also been filed in the Madras High Court relating to the alleged inconsistencies in his birth and parentage documents and even questioning his citizenship.
Bharti Jain is senior editor with The Times of India, New Delhi. She has been writing on security matters since 1996. Having covered the Union home ministry, security agencies, Election Commission and the ‘prime’ political beat, the Congress, for The Economic Times all these years, she moved to TOI in August 2012. Her repertoire of news stories delves into the whole gamut of issues related to terrorism and internal strife, besides probing strategic affairs in India’s neighbourhood.

title: Kerala HC declines to interfere with State govt’s reconstitution of Waqf Board
description: Kerala HC won't halt the state’s reconstitution of the Waqf Board, noting the board was already functional.
author: PTI
content:
The Kerala High Court on Tuesday (November 24, 2026) declined to interfere with the Keralam government’s decision to reconstitute the State Waqf Board, saying that it was already functional.
A Bench of justices Devan Ramachandran and Basant Balaji was hearing appeals by K S Hamza and C K Usman Haji, the former chairperson and member of the earlier board that was disbanded barely eight months into its five-year term, against a single judge order declining to stay the reconstitution of the board.
The single judge, on October 17, had refused to stay the reconstitution of the board but said that it would be subject to the outcome of the petitions challenging the same.
The judge had also tagged the petitions by Hamza and Haji with the earlier PILs – challenging the validity of the previous and now disbanded board – which were pending before a Bench headed by Chief Justice Soumen Sen.
However, the Bench headed by the Chief Justice on October 19 dismissed the PILs as the board had been reconstituted.
On Tuesday, the Bench of justices Devan Ramachandran and Basant Balaji directed the Registry that the earlier petitions of Hamza and Haji be listed before the appropriate Bench.

title: Why has the FSSAI sanctioned prosecution against Bisleri? | Explained
description: FSSAI moves to prosecute Bisleri after unsafe bromate and PAH findings prompt tougher rules for India’s packaged drinking water.
author: Kartikey  Singh
content:
The story so far: On November 22, the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI), the country’s apex food-safety regulator, sanctioned prosecution against packaged drinking water manufacturer Bisleri International Pvt. Ltd. after a sample of its water was found to be non-compliant with prescribed safety standards, with the regulator declaring it unsafe under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
The public-health stakes are significant. In 2023, bottled water was the principal source of drinking water for 15% of urban and 6% of rural households, as per Data For India. For consumers buying it at railway stations, airports, highway eateries and neighbourhood shops, a sealed bottle is often taken as an assurance of safety. Yet, the data submitted in Parliament in February 2025 revealed that 333 of 1,300 enforcement samples of packaged drinking water tested in 2023-24 failed to meet prescribed standards. Similarly, in 2022-23, 650 of 1,776 samples had been found non-compliant.
According to the FSSAI, a sample of packaged drinking water (other than mineral water) collected from Bisleri’s premises was found to be non-compliant with the prescribed limits for “bromate” and was declared unsafe under the 2006 Act. Following an appeal by the food business operator (FBO), the sample was referred to a Referral Food Laboratory for further examination, which also declared the sample unsafe, citing the detection of “polynuclear aromatic hydrocarbons” (PAHs).
In its response, Bisleri has maintained that its water is safe for consumption, saying the matter concerned a batch manufactured at its Goa facility in September 2025, one of 143 manufacturing plants in its network. In a statement issued on November 23, the company said the FSSAI had collected six samples from its Goa facility on September 30, 2025. While five samples met the prescribed standards, the sixth recorded a “bromate” level of 12 micrograms per litre, against the prescribed limit of 10 micrograms per litre. Further, Bisleri said it appealed on November 22, 2025, following which the sample was sent to a referral laboratory for retesting. The laboratory, as claimed, found the bromate level within the prescribed limit but separately detected PAHs. Citing the divergent test findings, the company reportedly arranged an independent examination of the same sample at an FSSAI-approved laboratory, which, according to Bisleri, also found the bromate level within limits. The company said it submitted these results to FSSAI’s Western Regional Office on February 2, 2026, but received no further communication and understood that the matter had been closed.
Water is essential for digestion, blood circulation, temperature regulation and kidney function, but its safety cannot be judged by its appearance, taste, odour or sealed packaging alone. Contamination may be microbiological, causing illnesses such as diarrhoea, cholera and typhoid, or chemical, with some substances posing risks through prolonged exposure. In India, packaged water broadly falls into two categories: (1) “packaged drinking water”, which may be sourced from surface water, groundwater or seawater and treated through processes such as filtration, decantation, reverse osmosis (RO) and disinfection; and (2) “natural mineral water”, drawn from protected underground sources and characterised by a relatively stable mineral composition. Both must meet prescribed chemical and microbiological safety standards.

title: No power can harm India as long as it reveres Sikh Gurus, says U.P. CM Adityanath
description: Yogi Adityanath emphasizes reverence for Sikh Gurus as India's shield, highlighting Guru Nanak's teachings for unity, equality, and national harmony.
author: Mayank Kumar
content:
Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath on Tuesday (November 24, 2026) said that no power in the world will be able to harm India as long as it continues to hold Sikh Gurus in reverence and respect.
“The sacrifice, penance, martyrdom, and spiritual consciousness of the Sikh Gurus are invaluable treasures of India’s national unity, social harmony, and cultural pride,” Mr. Adityanath said, addressing a program organised on the occasion of the 557th Prakash Parv of Sahib Shri Guru Nanak Dev Ji in Lucknow .
“Through ‘Ek Onkar’, Guru Nanak Dev Ji Maharaj gave the message of uniting all humanity. His teachings remain as relevant today as they were then. We must not confine these teachings to events and celebrations alone, but imbibe them in our lives and continuously familiarize the younger generation with them as well,” he added.
Referring to the spiritual and religious significance of Kartik Purnima, the U.P. Chief Minister said, “Today is an extremely sacred day for entire state. Since 4 am, I have been receiving updates on the number of devotees and arrangements at various religious sites across the state. At Shukratal in Muzaffarnagar, lakhs of devotees are taking a holy dip in the Ganga.
At Garhmukteshwar in Hapur, approximately 15 lakh devotees took a holy dip on Tuesday. Meanhwhile, more than 15 lakh devotees took a dip of faith in the Ganga at Tigri in Amroha. A large number of devotees also arrived in Prayagraj and Farrukhabad, while lakhs of them visited the Ganga in Ayodhya and Kashi,”.
Referring to the journeys undertaken by Guru Nanak Dev Ji and social conditions prevailing during his time, Mr. Adityanath said, “When he conveyed the message of unity to humanity, society was grappling with numerous social evils and divisions. Society was fragmented in the name of caste, untouchability and discrimination.
At the same time, he said foreign invasions and external attacks posed challenges. During such difficult times, Guru Nanak Dev Ji Maharaj united all humanity through the mantra of ‘Ek Onkar’. His clear message was that God is one and we are all His children. Therefore, every human being deserves equal respect. This mantra, given by him, became a great force for uniting society at that time, and it remains relevant even today. Despite limited means and resources, Guru Nanak Dev Ji Maharaj traveled to various places and spread the message of humanity, equality and spiritual consciousness among the masses,”.
Explaining the three principal teachings of Guru Nanak Dev Ji Maharaj, ‘Naam Japo, Kirat Karo, Vand Chhako’, the U.P. CM added, “Remembering God, performing kirtan and embracing the spirit of togetherness generate positive feelings within human beings. This dispels ignorance and awakens the strength of unity in society,”..

title: IRISET takes Kavach training to campuses, signs MoUs with 26 engineering colleges
description: IRISET has partnered 26 engineering colleges, with eight introducing elective courses on Kavach, as the institute expands training to support the indigenous train protection system's rollout.
author: V. Geetanath
content:
With the rollout of the indigenous train protection system ‘Kavach’ gaining pace, the Indian Railways Institute of Signal Engineering and Telecommunications (IRISET) is taking its training efforts beyond the Railways, partnering 26 engineering colleges to build a wider pool of skilled professionals.
Of the 26 institutions that signed Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) with IRISET, eight have introduced open elective courses on Kavach, the indigenously developed Automatic Train Protection (ATP) system.
Addressing the institute’s annual day celebrations on Tuesday (November 24, 2026), Director General Piush Kumar Gupta said Kavach remains IRISET’s primary training focus. A two-week, design-oriented course has emerged as one of its most sought-after programmes among signalling and telecommunications professionals. So far, 187 officers and 1,031 supervisors have undergone training in these courses.
A one-week crash course conducted last year trained 542 Signal and Telecommunications (S&T) officers to support the rapid rollout of Kavach across the railway network. The institute also conducted 14 customised courses on fitting Kavach equipment in locomotives for officers and supervisors from electric loco sheds and production units, benefiting 315 participants.
In addition, 56 specialised programmes on signalling and Kavach were organised for 3,150 Chief Loco Inspectors (CLIs). IRISET also uploaded 18 online courses covering Kavach, signalling, telecommunications and information technology, with a combined duration of over 30 hours, on the iGOT Karmayogi portal. These courses have benefited more than 46,000 employees.
To meet emerging technological requirements, the institute introduced five new courses covering cloud computing, big data analytics, data science, AI applications and cyber security.
Established in 1957, IRISET conducted 261 training programmes for over 7,000 participants, recording a 50% increase in trainee-days over the previous year.
It also trained 343 apprentices, including 175 signal engineers, 115 telecom engineers and 53 design engineers. Another 291 apprentices and 53 executives of the Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Ltd (DFCCIL) are currently undergoing training.
Its 20-part webinar series attracted over 3,200 railway and industry personnel. Besides mandatory courses on electronic interlocking, automatic block signalling, VoIP-based exchanges and LTE, the institute conducted practical and appreciation courses for 110 Indian Railway Management Service (IRMS) Traffic probationers and 60 B.Tech students of Gati Shakti Vishwavidyalaya. Faculty development programmes on AI and data science were also organised.

title: ‘Will take Bangladesh by Dec 16’: Bengal minister’s controversial remark amid tensions over alleged Hindu killings | India News
description: Sheikh Hasina's spokesperson said that the former PM intended to travel from Delhi to Dhaka on December 16 aboard Bangladesh's national carrier. | India News
author: ANI
content:
‘Will take Bangladesh by Dec 16’: Bengal minister’s controversial remark amid tensions over alleged Hindu killings
Sheikh Hasina's spokesperson said that the former PM intended to travel from Delhi to Dhaka on December 16 aboard Bangladesh's national carrier.
West Bengal minister Arjun Singh has claimed that the country would take over Bangladesh by December 16 and that the killings of Hindus in the neighbouring country would be "avenged".
Speaking to reporters in Bhatpara, he made a controversial remark about Bangladesh on Tuesday, saying, "We will take Bangladesh by December 16th. Enough is enough; there are no more excuses regarding Bangladesh. We will certainly take revenge for the way Hindus have been killed in Bangladesh; there is no doubt about that."
His remarks came amid tensions in Bangladesh, where the country's State Minister for Foreign Affairs, Humayun Kobir, earlier said that former Prime Minister and Awami League chief Sheikh Hasina would only be allowed to return to the country as a prisoner, in handcuffs and under strict surveillance.
Deep Dive
Kobir reportedly made the remarks while addressing journalists after briefing foreign diplomats at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in Dhaka. Dismissing Hasina's reported plan to return to Bangladesh from India on December 16, coinciding with the country's Victory Day celebrations, he said, "Desire and reality are two different things."
"The reality is that a terrorist will never be allowed to return except through extradition... She is not a regular commercial passenger. She can only be brought back in handcuffs and under strict surveillance," The Business Standard quoted Kobir as saying.
Earlier, Hasina's spokesperson, Syed Mozammel Ali, had informed Reuters that the former Prime Minister intended to travel from Delhi to Dhaka on December 16 aboard Bangladesh's national carrier, Biman Bangladesh Airlines.
In an official communication, Ali said that Hasina had sought arrangements from the Dhaka administration for her return journey. "Since Sheikh Hasina was flown to India on a Bangladesh aircraft on August 5, 2024, she now calls upon the government to arrange for her air transport from Delhi back to Dhaka," Ali said, according to Reuters.
Separately, Bangladesh's International Crimes Tribunal (ICT) Chief Prosecutor Md Aminul Islam reportedly described Hasina's demand for a state aircraft to facilitate her return as "nothing but madness".
Meanwhile, A Bangladeshi minister had informed Reuters on Sunday that Hasina faced immediate arrest and imprisonment if she returned, noting that no formal talks had taken place with India regarding the dispatch of a plane for her travel.
Hasina, who led Bangladesh as prime minister from 2009 until 2024, arrived in India on August 5, 2024, in the wake of a student-led agitation over public sector job quotas that escalated into a nationwide uprising against her Awami League administration.
She was later handed a death sentence in absentia by Bangladesh's International Crimes Tribunal over charges of crimes against humanity linked to the suppression of protesters, allegations that Hasina has denied.
Hasina initially declared her wish to return to Bangladesh at a virtual media briefing in August this year and has repeated those plans during several subsequent interviews. Earlier this month, she also applied for a new passport and national identity card through legal representatives in the United Kingdom.
Dhaka has made repeated requests to India for her extradition, while New Delhi has maintained that the matter is under examination.

title: 69 former bureaucrats seek scrapping of Arunachal Pradesh’s Demwe dam over ecological concerns | India News
description: The project remained stalled owing to financial difficulties faced by its developer, among other factors, before being acquired by the Greenko Group in 2026. | India News
author: Damien Lepcha
content:
69 former bureaucrats seek scrapping of Arunachal Pradesh’s Demwe dam over ecological concerns
The project remained stalled owing to financial difficulties faced by its developer, among other factors, before being acquired by the Greenko Group in 2026.
A group of 69 former bureaucrats has urged the Union environment ministry to scrap the proposed 1,750 MW Demwe Lower Hydroelectric Project on the Lohit River in Arunachal Pradesh, citing concerns about its potentially devastating impact on biodiversity, indigenous communities, and the fragile ecology of the eastern Himalayas.
In a letter dated November 23, also addressed to the Arunachal Pradesh chief minister Pema Khandu and the Standing Committee of the National Board for Wildlife (SC-NBWL), the former officials questioned the repeated attempts by successive governments to push ahead with the project despite scientific objections, legal interventions and sustained local opposition.
The signatories include former Delhi lieutenant governor Najeeb Jung and former Kerala principal chief conservator of forests Prakriti Srivastava.
No response was immediately available from the Union environment ministry or the Arunachal administration.
What the letter says
According to the letter, the project would require the diversion of 1,416 hectares of forest land, submerge nearly 1,590 hectares and necessitate the felling of around 43,000 trees in an ecologically sensitive evergreen rainforest.
“It (the project) is being pursued since 2011 by different governments, in spite of the havoc it will create on endemic wildlife as well as on tropical rainforests and people,” the letter stated.
The former bureaucrats said opposition to the project dates back to 2010, when it received initial environmental clearance, prompting Mishmi and other indigenous communities, environmental groups and civil society organisations to mobilise against the proposed dam to protect the sacred Parashuram Kund and downstream ecosystems.
They warned that the project could threaten the survival of the critically endangered white-bellied heron, as well as fragment tiger habitats and disrupt wildlife connectivity across the larger landscape encompassing Kamlang, Namdapha, and the proposed Dibang Tiger Reserve.
The letter also raised questions over the project’s chequered history of regulatory approvals.
When the proposal was placed before the SC-NBWL in October 2011, all its non-official expert members opposed the project, citing serious downstream ecological consequences. However, the then Union environment minister granted wildlife clearance in 2012, overriding their objections, the signatories said.
The decision was subsequently challenged before the National Green Tribunal (NGT), which in 2017 suspended the project’s approvals and directed the wildlife panel to undertake a fresh examination of the proposal, including its cumulative downstream impacts.
The former bureaucrats alleged that a reconstituted wildlife committee cleared the project in 2018 without undertaking the comprehensive multi-seasonal assessment sought by the tribunal, relying instead on what they described as a flawed Wildlife Institute of India study.
The project remained stalled owing to financial difficulties faced by its developer, among other factors, before being acquired by the Greenko Group in 2026.
Questioning the latest regulatory exercise, the signatories said the SC-NBWL, reconstituted in March 2026 with only two independent experts, considered the proposal in July primarily to approve the change of project developer from Athena to Greenko.
They alleged that the committee failed to undertake a comprehensive fresh wildlife assessment in accordance with the NGT’s directions and continued to rely on scientific data from 2018.
The former officials also challenged the strategic argument that large dams in Arunachal Pradesh could help India establish prior appropriation rights over river waters and counter China’s upstream hydropower activities in the Brahmaputra basin.
They argued that in the absence of a bilateral water-sharing treaty, downstream infrastructure would not prevent China from diverting water upstream.
The letter further claimed that nearly 70%-80% of the Brahmaputra River system’s total water volume in India originates in Arunachal Pradesh and Assam, primarily from heavy monsoon rainfall and snowmelt.
The signatories urged the authorities to reconsider the project’s viability in light of its ecological, social and legal implications rather than pursuing its development despite longstanding objections.

title: SP’s candidate list sparks friction with Congress; Masood questions ‘seriousness’ in forming alliance | India News

author: HT Correspondent
content:
SP’s candidate list sparks friction with Congress; Masood questions ‘seriousness’ in forming alliance
The Congress had reportedly sought 181 constituencies in the state, while the SP’s opening offer stood at 26 seats during discussions in Delhi.
The Samajwadi Party (SP)'s decision to release a list of five candidates for the Uttar Pradesh assembly elections amid seat-sharing talks with the Congress has triggered friction within the Opposition alliance, with Congress MP Imran Masood on Wednesday questioning the Akhilesh Yadav-led party's “seriousness” about forging a tie-up.
Masood said the SP appeared to be holding discussions with the Congress on one hand and making electoral declarations on the other, which he said raised “questions about its intent”.
“Whatever is happening here, it seems that there is a lack of seriousness in this matter. While you [Samajwadi Party] are holding talks on one side, you are making declarations on the other. This indicates that the matter is not being taken seriously,” news agency PTI quoted Masood, the Congress’s UP working president, as saying.
Also read: SP releases first list of 5 candidates for UP Assembly polls amid seat-sharing talks
Deep Dive
The SP on Tuesday evening released its first list of candidates for next year’s Uttar Pradesh assembly elections, renominating four sitting MLAs and fielding a former party district president in a seat held by the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP). The announcement came hours after the SP made the Congress an “opening offer” of 26 of the state’s 403 seats during talks in Delhi.
Tuesday’s list named Umar Ali Khan from Behat and Ashu Malik from Saharanpur, both in Saharanpur district, Nahid Hasan from Kairana in Shamli, Mehboob Ali from Amroha and Jyoti Lodhi from Lalitpur. Behat and Saharanpur were reportedly among the seats in a probable list of 181 constituencies sought by the Congress, though neither side has confirmed the list. The Congress had earlier demanded that it should have a say in candidates for the seats in the Saharanpur— the district from which Masood is the sitting MP.
Also read: Old alliance, new dynamics: Decoding the SAD-BJP reunion
“When you have made this declaration against me, I don't understand whether you want to fight me, the Congress or the BJP. It has to be decided whether you want to fight the BJP or fight us,” Masood said, according to PTI.
He added: “We will discuss within our party what we should do and whether we should sit for talks or not. The decision on how to proceed in this situation will be taken by the party.”
There was no immediate reaction from the SP to his remarks.

BJP, Akali Dal ‘natural alliance partners’, says West Bengal minister Dilip Ghosh ahead of 2027 Punjab polls
He dismissed the INDIA bloc as lacking unity. The parties recently signalled plans to contest the 2027 Punjab Assembly elections together.
West Bengal Minister Dilip Ghosh on Wednesday described the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and the Akali Dal (SAD) as "natural alliance partners", expressing support for the continuation of their political alliance in the interest of Punjab and the nation.
Ghosh said the two parties had shared an association for several years and that their partnership was based on ideological similarities and mutual understanding.
"The Akali Dal and the BJP are natural alliance partners—they have been with us for years, not just recently," Ghosh told ANI.
Deep Dive
He acknowledged that circumstances could sometimes lead to the two parties parting ways but maintained that their ideological alignment remained strong, providing a basis for their association to continue.

"While circumstances may occasionally lead to a separation, there is a strong alignment in terms of ideology and other aspects," he said.
Taking a swipe at the INDIA bloc, Ghosh contrasted the BJP-SAD relationship with the opposition alliance, describing the latter as an arrangement without a strong political foundation. He questioned the nature of the INDIA alliance, alleging that its formation lacked the ideological and organisational unity that he attributed to the BJP's alliance partners.
"In contrast, the INDIA alliance is entirely unnatural; they simply sat together, had tea for two days, and declared an alliance," he said.
Ghosh further alleged that the opposition alliance had no substantial political presence across the country and dismissed it as an arrangement formed through meetings in the national capital.
Also Read | BJP-SAD’s renewed alliance sets stage for 3-cornered contest in Chandigarh
"The INDIA alliance has no real existence anywhere in the country—it amounts to nothing more than a tea party in Delhi," he said.
Drawing a parallel with other parties associated with the BJP, Ghosh referred to the Shiv Sena and said the Akali Dal was also among the parties that had maintained an alliance with the BJP. He pointed out that several other political parties had joined the BJP-led alliance over the years.
"Just as the Shiv Sena is our alliance partner, so too is the Akali Dal, along with many other parties that have joined us," he said.
Emphasising the importance of the BJP-SAD partnership, Ghosh said the alliance should continue, citing the interests of Punjab and the country as the reasons for maintaining the association.
"Therefore, in the interest of the nation and the interest of Punjab, the alliance between the Akali Dal and the BJP should remain intact and continue to move forward," he said.

Earlier on Tuesday, Union Home Minister Amit Shah , BJP President Nitin Nabin and Shiromani Akali Dal President Sukhbir Badal met on Tuesday in the capital to formally as they signalled a tie-up between the two parties for the 2027 Punjab Assembly elections and the strengthening of the National Democratic Alliance.
At the BJP headquarters, leaders from both parties formally signalled an intent to take on the ruling Aam Aadmi Party and the Congress.
Amit Shah said, "Both the BJP and the Akali Dal have decided to fight the Punjab Assembly elections together, and the Akali Dal will also join the NDA from today. This is a great occasion that on Guru Purab the Akali Dal, one of our oldest allies, is returning to the NDA."

title: Operation Trident: How Myanmar kingpin used homemakers, hawala to fuel drug trafficking network | India News
description: The NCB said that the so-called Golden Triangle remains the main source of methamphetamine entering India | India News
author: Prawesh Lama
content:
Prawesh Lama, an Associate Editor at Hindustan Times with nearly two decades of frontline reporting experience across India’s conflict zones, border regions, and disaster-hit areas. He writes on internal security, insurgency, the Northeast, and Left-wing extremism and has reported from India’s hinterland and some of the most sensitive and strategically critical regions.
Operation Trident: How Myanmar kingpin used homemakers, hawala to fuel drug trafficking network
The NCB said that the so-called Golden Triangle remains the main source of methamphetamine entering India
The Narcotics Control Bureau (NCB) has filed a charge sheet against Thangcintuang alias Chintuang from Myanmar, identified as the alleged kingpin of a major drug trafficking network operating between Myanmar and India. Over two dozen people have so far been arrested across Mizoram, Manipur, Assam and Tripura in the case. The investigation is continuing. The National Investigation Agency (NIA) made its latest arrest in the case of a man from Assam on November 16.
Chintuang’s interrogation provided the basis for Operation Trident, which three central agencies and four state police forces launched on October 23. The operation involved raids at 18 locations across Mizoram, Manipur and Assam, resulting in the arrest of 18 accused. Investigators unearthed evidence of hawala transactions worth over ₹100 crore, which led to the freezing of 1,424 bank accounts.
HT has accessed the charge sheet the NCB filed against Chintuang before a special court in Aizawl, Mizoram, on November 14. The document details how drug kingpins based in Myanmar, such as Chintuang, channel narcotics into India through an extensive cross-border network. The NCB will file charge sheets against the other accused. Chintuang is lodged in a Mizoram jail.
This charge sheet is significant as it offers a detailed account of what the government has described as one of the largest cross-border organised drug networks busted by multiple agencies. With the Centre setting December 31, 2029, as the deadline to dismantle drug networks from India, the modus operandi of these drug networks shows the scale, reach and operational complexity of the challenge.
The networks used people walking and driving across the international border to transport drugs. Women, many of them homemakers, were allegedly paid commissions to rent out their bank accounts for depositing drug money. Bank accounts in the names of Indian nationals were operated by Myanmar residents. Money exchangers worked as hawala operators, and translators helped the networks communicate freely.
The source and suppliers in Myanmar
Chintuang, 38, who is from Bulfec village in Myanmar’s Chin State, was arrested in Greater Noida in May when he came to meet his contacts. According to the charge sheet, he confessed that drug consignments were generally procured from suppliers in Tahan in the Saging region of Myanmar, around 150km from Mizoram’s border village in Champhai district. The drugs were brought by road to the Indo-Myanmar border via Tedim and stocked in the border villages of Myanmar such as Fartlang and Bulfek.
The drugs were stocked, and orders were received from Indian suppliers across the northeastern states. The charge sheet quotes Chintuang identifying four major Myanmar-based suppliers, H Pianga, Kamthang, Zamseinlian alias Liana and Thangkhen, involved in supplying heroin and methamphetamine.
“He communicated with them through WhatsApp, Viber and Facebook Messenger to arrange consignments, negotiate quantities and coordinate transportation,” the charge sheet said.
The four Myanmar nationals are yet to be arrested. The charge sheet identifies Chintuang as the principal and only intermediary between the Myanmar suppliers and Indian buyers. His role, according to the NCB, was to receive the drugs in Myanmar, coordinate their movement towards the border and arrange their delivery to buyers in India.
According to the charge sheet, Chintuang studied in Chennai and travelled in the northeast to expand the network. The charge sheet added that he obtained an Aadhaar card by posing as a resident of Bethel village in Champhai, Mizoram.
Drugs from Myanmar into India
The charge sheet cited Chintuang’s confession saying drug delivery points were generally selected along the banks of the Tiau River, in open fields and at other isolated locations along the India-Myanmar border. The Tiau, which forms the international boundary between the two countries, has shallow stretches in Mizoram that allow people to cross freely and illegally.
The 1,643-km India-Myanmar border remains unfenced and is frequently exploited by drug trafficking networks. To curb such illegal activities, the Centre has decided to fence the border, along the lines of the India-Pakistan and India-Bangladesh borders. The Border Roads Organisation has so far completed around 100 km of fencing.
“Consignments were generally moved across the border by human carriers near the Tiau River and delivered to designated locations, including Ngur, Zote, Hnalan and other areas of Mizoram’s Champhai district,” Chintuang said in his statement. He identified the human carriers as Neih Khup, KC Mawite, Huaipi, Khampi Tiau and Lianbawi, all from Myanmar. The four are yet to be arrested.
The Centre has in recent years identified Champhai district as a key drug trafficking hotspot, given that a substantial volume of narcotics from the so-called Golden Triangle enters India through this corridor. In June 2026, the Centre approved the setting up of a zonal office of the NCB in Aizawl to intensify its crackdown on drug trafficking through the region.
The NCB’s 2025 annual report stated that the so-called Golden Triangle, comprising parts of Myanmar, Thailand and Laos, remains the main source of methamphetamine entering India through the northeast. Investigators believe that to meet the December 31, 2029, deadline for dismantling all drug networks, it is important to identify key players like Chintuang and other beneficiaries who aid such drug networks.
Union home minister Amit Shah has said that after meeting the March 31, 2026, target of making India Maoist-free, the government is working to declare India free of the drug mafia by the end of 2029.
How the drugs moved
The NCB charge sheet details a 2024 drug seizure in Mizoram, showing how a consignment of 2.804 kg of heroin and 14.082 kg of methamphetamine was transported from Myanmar to India. The drugs were seized near Dulte village in Mizoram’s Khawzawl district on July 24, 2024, when four men were arrested. The investigation established Chintuang’s alleged role, leading to his arrest.
According to the investigation, Mohammed Iman Hossain, Ripon Hossain and Niranjan Karmakar left Sonamura in Tripura in a Mahindra Bolero on July 19, 2024. Acting on the instructions of Guwahati resident Abu Saleh Mohammed Saifuddin, they travelled more than 500 km to Champhai in Mizoram. There, they were to contact a local man, Vungkhanthawna, who acted as a translator and guide to help them cross the Tiau River into Myanmar through its shallow stretches.
“After reaching Mizoram, the three parked the vehicle at New Champhai Petrol Pump (Mizoram) and moved to Bulfek village, Myanmar, illegally by crossing the Tiau River on foot,” the charge sheet said. The three stayed at Chintuang’s house in Bulfek, Myanmar. Vungkhanthawna arranged a driver for the vehicle to be driven across the river into Myanmar to Chintuang’s residence. Vungkhanthawna also acted as an interpreter between the three Indians and Chintuang. At Chintuang’s house, they welded a tin sheet to one side of their vehicle to create a concealed compartment for transporting heroin and methamphetamine.
The following morning, July 22, the men crossed the Tiau River back into India with the drugs. In his statement recorded in the charge sheet, Vungkhanthawna said his role was to arrange drugs through his Myanmar-based associates, including Chintuang, act as an interpreter, facilitate the illegal movement of vehicles from Myanmar into India through the river, and arrange accommodation for Indian nationals in Myanmar during drug deliveries. The four men were intercepted on July 24 while returning from the trip, and the drugs were seized. After their interrogation, the agencies learnt about Chintuang, identified him as the kingpin, launched a manhunt, and finally caught him almost two years later.
Homemakers and bank accounts
One of the more striking aspects of the modus operandi detailed in the charge heet is how the drug network allegedly moved money across the India-Myanmar border without physically transferring cash. Chintuang allegedly recruited people in India to rent out their bank accounts, which were then used to deposit and transfer money collected from drug sales. Payments to Myanmar were subsequently settled through hawala channels.
For renting bank accounts, each account holder was paid ₹2,500- ₹3,000 for every 10 lakh deposited to their account by the Indian drug buyers. The charge sheet records at least 26 Indian bank accounts allegedly used by the network’s associates to receive money. Tracing these transactions led the NCB, along with state police and the Enforcement Directorate (ED), to arrest at least six women last month, most of them homemakers, under Operation Trident.
One of the arrested women, Lalrampari, allegedly operated eight bank accounts of her own and also used her husband’s account. She charged a commission of ₹1,000 for every ₹1 lakh transacted through the accounts, according to the charge sheet. “Chintuang stated that he had transferred ₹5 crore to her allegedly generated through drug money.” The charge sheet detailed the accounts and transactions between 2004 and 2026.
Lamrampari allegedly posed as a money exchanger but was dealing in hawala by receiving cash from Indian buyers and getting her sources in Myanmar to pay off the suppliers.
The probe agencies have found evidence of almost ₹100 crore hawala transactions, linked to the network, which prompted the ED to join the probe. The money from the accounts was routed through different entities in Manipur and Mizoram. In one such route, agencies found the money was routed within India by sending it to pharmacies, departmental shop owners, etc., who too are under probe.
Another woman, Awilunvung, a homemaker who had five bank accounts, had transactions worth ₹4 crore routed through her six accounts.
The ED is probing money laundering, as several of the bank accounts operated by the women recorded transactions running into crores of rupees, with individual accounts showing amounts of up to ₹1-2 crore. The agency is probing the possible involvement of bank officials. Investigators are examining how foreign nationals, including Myanmar residents, allegedly came to operate accounts in Indian public and private sector banks.
The NCB’s charge sheet filed on November 15 said that the agency has issued notices to branch managers of at least three banks, asking them to appear before the agency for questioning. NCB officials said their statements, which will be recorded, will form a crucial part of the supplementary charge sheet. Their questioning is expected to help investigators establish the larger role of corrupt bank officials, as many account holders mentioned addresses in their accounts that were fake.
The ED said in a statement a day after Operation Trident last month that the investigation exposed an interconnected narco-hawala ecosystem in which the same set of bank accounts in Champhai, Aizawl and Lawngtlai receive drug money generated in Manipur, Mizoram, Assam and Tripura and settle it with suppliers in Myanmar. “Heroin and methamphetamine tablets entering Mizoram and Manipur are consumed locally and moved onward through Assam to the rest of India and Bangladesh, while the drug money generated across this chain flows back to the border towns of Mizoram for settlement with Myanmar-based suppliers.”

Assam triple murder case: Two accused injured in encounter; two constables hurt

Two persons accused of murdering a retired employee of Oil India Limited (OIL), his wife and daughter in Assam’s Duliajan earlier this month were injured in an encounter with police on Tuesday night, police confirmed on Wednesday.
According to police, the two accused, Raju Das and Amir Das, who were in police custody, had allegedly tried to escape by overpowering a police team while on their way to recover the murder weapon when the incident took place.
“The accused had confessed to us earlier on Tuesday that they had hidden the murder weapon, a hammer, at a place in Balijan. A police team had taken the accused to the spot at night to recover it when they tried to overpower our team and flee,” said Nirmal Ghosh, additional superintendent of police (ASP) (crime) of Dibrugarh district.

“In order to prevent them from escaping under cover of darkness, our team fired four rounds towards them in which they were injured. They were first taken to Tengakhat primary health centre and then to Assam Medical College and Hospital for treatment,” he added.
According to police, the incident took place between 11pm and 12am near Balijan tea estate. While Raju Das sustained bullet injury on his right leg, Amir Das was injured on his left leg. Two police constables, Manoj Lahon and Nitul Saikia, who were injured in the incident are getting treatment at Duliajan civil hospital.
The bodies of retired OIL employee Chandrakanta Bhuyan (64), his wife Eliza Bhuyan (55) and daughter Niharika Bhuyan (28) were found in the home at Duliajan on November 16 with wound marks.
A day later police arrested Raju (27) and Amir (27) from the Simalaguri railway station while they were attempting to leave the state. Police said the accused had been living as tenants in the Bhuyan house and were closely involved in maintaining the household, almost like members of the family.

title: Two IPS officers fight at late-night party in Assam, SSP injured; CM Sarma calls it ‘personal matter’ | India News
description: The police department has not officially confirmed the incident or released a statement, but Assam CM Himanta Biswa Sarma said he was aware of the matter. | India News
author: Biswa Kalyan Purkayastha
content:
Two IPS officers fight at late-night party in Assam, SSP injured; CM Sarma calls it ‘personal matter’
The police department has not officially confirmed the incident or released a statement, but Assam CM Himanta Biswa Sarma said he was aware of the matter.
A late-night party organised by senior superintendent of police (SSP) Akshat Garg in Assam's Kokrajhar district during the last weekend allegedly turned into a physical altercation between two senior Indian Police Service (IPS) officers, including the host.
As per police sources, an argument broke out between Garg and deputy inspector general (DIG) of the Western Range, YT Gyatso, following a verbal disagreement and escalated into a physical confrontation in which Garg sustained multiple injuries.
The incident took place at the premises of the 7th Assam Police Battalion in Saraikhola. The police department has not officially confirmed the incident or released a statement, but Assam chief minister Himanta Biswa Sarma on Tuesday said he was aware of the matter.
Sarma, however, called it a personal matter and said, "This happened at a private party, and the officers were not on duty. This was a personal matter, and since they were not on duty, we cannot say anything."
He added, "If this had happened when they were on duty, we would have intervened and taken necessary steps."
Assam Police headquarters has not issued an official statement on the alleged incident so far.
Sources said the DGP had asked senior IPS officer Surendra Kumar to intervene and facilitate a reconciliation between the two officers.
The circumstances surrounding the confrontation, the nature of Garg's injuries, the role of others present at the gathering and whether a formal departmental inquiry has been initiated remain unclear.
CM Sarma's message on police conduct
Earlier on Tuesday, while addressing a passing-out parade of newly recruited Assam Police personnel at the Lachit Barphukan Police Academy in Dergaon, the chief minister issued a series of instructions on how police officers and personnel should conduct themselves while dealing with the public.
He told the recruits to stay away from intoxicating substances, refrain from using abusive or indecent language and ensure their speech, behaviour, and overall conduct reflected the dignity of the uniform.

title: संसद के अगले सत्र पर सस्पेंस: विपक्ष ने कहा, 'सरकार बहुमत जुटाने में जुटी, BJP को डर'
description: राज्यसभा सांसद और वरिष्ठ वकील कपिल सिब्बल ने कहा कि मानसून सत्र का सत्रावसान क्यों नहीं हुआ है. शीतकालीन सत्र 20 नवंबर के आसपास बुलाया जाता है. नहीं बुलाया गया है. ये संविधान का उल्लंघन है.
author: जीवन प्रकाश
content:
संसद के अगले सत्र पर सस्पेंस: विपक्ष ने कहा, 'सरकार बहुमत जुटाने में जुटी, BJP को डर'
राज्यसभा सांसद और वरिष्ठ वकील कपिल सिब्बल ने कहा कि मानसून सत्र का सत्रावसान क्यों नहीं हुआ है. शीतकालीन सत्र 20 नवंबर के आसपास बुलाया जाता है. नहीं बुलाया गया है. ये संविधान का उल्लंघन है.
संसद के अगले सत्र को लेकर सस्पेंस बरकरार है. विपक्ष सरकार से लगातार पूछ रहा है कि मानसून सत्र का ही विस्तार होगा या फिर शीतकालीन सत्र बुलाएगी. सरकार ने अब तक मानसून सत्र का सत्रावसान क्यों नहीं किया है. साथ ही विपक्षी दलों का कहना है कि सरकार परिसीमन बिल पास कराने के लिए बहुमत जुटाने में जुटी है. इसलिए देरी कर रही है.
राज्यसभा सांसद कपिल सिब्बल ने प्रेस कॉन्फ्रेंस कर कहा, ''मानसून सत्र का सत्रावसान क्यों नहीं हुआ है. शीतकालीन सत्र 20 नवंबर के आसपास बुलाया जाता है. नहीं बुलाया गया है. एक सत्र और दूसरे सत्र के बीच में 180 दिनों का अंतर नहीं होना चाहिए. मानसून सत्र अब तक खत्म नहीं हुआ है, तो अब जब भी बुलाया जाएगा तो उसे तो मानसून सत्र ही कहा जाएगा. इसका मतलब है कि शीतकालीन सत्र होगा ही नहीं. इसका मतलब है कि सीधा बजट सत्र होगा. ये संविधान का उल्लंघन है.''
उन्होंने कहा, ''मानसून सत्र सत्रावसान नहीं करने के पीछे सोच क्या है.संविधान संशोधन बिल ला रहे हैं, इनका मकसद लोकसभा की सीट बढ़ाने की है. उसके बाद परिसीमन करेंगे.कारण दिया गया है कि महिला आरक्षण बिल को लागू करना चाहते हैं. ये तो हम भी कह रहे हैं. इनकी सोच है कि इतिहास देखेंगे तो हिंदी भाषी राज्य में बीजेपी का प्रभाव रहा है, दक्षिण भारत में ज्यादा प्रभाव नहीं है. कर्नाटक-केरल में कुछ नहीं मिलता है. कर्नाटक में उलटफेर होता रहता है.''
बीजेपी ने संसद को हाईजैक कर लिया है- कांग्रेस
लोकसभा में कांग्रेस के उप-नेता गौरव गोगोई ने कहा कि सत्र बुलाने में हो रही देरी भारत की जनता के प्रति घोर अनादर को दर्शाती है. उन्होंने कहा कि बीजेपी ने संसद को हाईजैक कर लिया है. वे बिना किसी वजह के संसद के नवंबर-दिसंबर सत्र में देरी कर रहे हैं और जनता को इसका कोई कारण भी नहीं बता रहे हैं. बीजेपी एक ऐसी संसद से डरती है, जहां विपक्ष उनके सामने बैठकर तीखे सवाल पूछे.
कांग्रेस के वरिष्ठ नेता राजीव शुक्ला ने कहा, ''शीतकालीन सत्र में देरी हो रही है, किसी को पता नहीं है कि क्यों देरी हो रही है. पिछले सत्र का सत्रावसान भी नहीं हुआ है. ऐसे में कभी भी वो सत्र शुरू कर सकते हैं. कब करेंगे, कैसे करेंगे, क्या एजेंडा है...ये सरकार के कुछ ही लोगों को पता है. सत्र का सभी इंतजार कर रहे हैं.''
संजय राउत का वार
महिला आरक्षण और परिसीमन बिल पर शिवसेना यूबीटी के सांसद संजय राउत ने कहा कि INDIA गठबंधन परिसीमन के मुद्दे पर सामूहिक रूप से फैसला लेगा. यहां नैतिकता की बात नहीं है. बाहर से समर्थन देने से सरकार नहीं बनती. जो सांसद अभी संसद में हैं, उन्हें ही आरक्षण दीजिए. दो-तिहाई बहुमत जुटाने के लिए आपने क्या किया? पार्टियों को खरीदा जा रहा है. अमित शाह की तरफ से क्रॉस वोटिंग के लिए 150 करोड़ रुपये देने की बातें चल रही हैं. यह बिल एक बार गिर चुका है. अमित शाह इस मुद्दे पर जिद पर अड़े हुए हैं. जब तक आंकड़ा पूरा नहीं होगा, तब तक अधिवेशन नहीं होगा, यह किस तरह का अहंकार है?
शरद पवार के NDA में शामिल होने की चर्चा पर राउत ने कहा कि कुछ लोगों की ऐसी इच्छा जरूर है. शरद पवार का पूरा राजनीतिक जीवन सांप्रदायिक ताकतों के खिलाफ लड़ने और फुले-शाहू-आंबेडकर के विचारों को आगे बढ़ाने में बीता है. उनके राजनीतिक वारिसों और परिवार के लोगों को इस विरासत का ध्यान रखना चाहिए. सत्ता में जाने की जल्दबाजी में अगर शाहू-फुले के विचारों को दफनाया जा रहा है, तो यह उचित नहीं है. कुछ लोगों की सोच है कि आप आराम कीजिए, हम पार्टी तोड़कर आपको घर बैठा देंगे.
विपक्षी दलों की आशंकाओं के बीच बता दें कि परिसीमन बिल पर सरकार को दो तिहाई बहुमत की जरूरत है. उसे 361 वोट चाहिए. राष्ट्रीय जनतांत्रिक गठबंधन (NDA) के पास 320 सदस्य हैं. दावा है कि बीजेपी ने समर्थन के लिए शरद पवार और डीएमके प्रमुख एमके स्टालिन से संपर्क साधा है.
जॉन ब्रिटास ने क्या कहा?
भारतीय कम्युनिस्ट पार्टी (मार्क्सवादी) के राज्यसभा सांसद जॉन ब्रिटास ने एएनआई से कहा कि संसद के शीतकालीन सत्र को लेकर किसी को कोई जानकारी नहीं है. वहीं दूसरी ओर, बीजेपी पंजाब में जोड़-तोड़ और गठबंधन करने में काफी सक्रिय है. उत्तर प्रदेश में भी अपना प्रचार अभियान चला रही है, लेकिन पूरा देश इस सरकार की ओर देख रहा है कि संसद के शीतकालीन सत्र को लेकर उनका क्या रुख है. यह देश एक लोकतांत्रिक राष्ट्र के रूप में जिस बुनियादी आधार पर चल रहा है, वह संसदीय शासन प्रणाली है.
उन्होंने कहा, ''संसद वह मंच है जिसके जरिए सरकार की जवाबदेही तय की जाती है. अगर सरकार संसद के इतने महत्वपूर्ण सत्र को लेकर 'लुका-छिपी' का खेल खेल रही है, तो मुझे नहीं पता कि इस देश के लोकतंत्र के बारे में क्या कहा जाए. हर कोई जानता है कि पर्दे के पीछे ऐसी कोशिशें चल रही हैं जिससे 'परिसीमन विधेयक' को पास कराया जा सके, और वे इस संवैधानिक संशोधन विधेयक को पारित कराने के लिए बहुमत जुटाने की कोशिश कर रहे हैं.''
संदीप दीक्षित का निशाना
कांग्रेस के वरिष्ठ नेता संदीप दीक्षित ने न्यूज एजेंसी एएनआई से कहा कि इनका एक ही तरीका है कि किसी तरीके से कुछ मेजॉरिटी बनाकर टू थर्ड्स अपने डीलिमिटेशन को पास करें. वो इनके पास है नहीं. अब उसके लिए इन्होंने धन की वो शुरू की होगी. इधर उधर से खरीदना शुरू किया होगा. सौ दो सौ करोड़ प्रति सांसद जो भी इनके रेट होते हैं बांधे होंगे. हो सकता है अभी तक पूरी डीलिंग नहीं हुई होगी. जब डील हो जाएगी और इसके पहले कि दूसरा कहीं पैसे लेके भाग जाए उसके बीच में संसद का सत्र हो सकता है कर दें.
बता दें कि पिछले साल 8 नवंबर को शीतकालीन सत्र की घोषणा हुई थी और ये 1 दिसंबर 2025 को शुरू हुआ था और 19 दिसंबर 2025 को अनिश्चित काल के लिए स्थगित कर दिया गया.

title: 'गांधी परिवार के गढ़ में सिर्फ एक सीट...', कांग्रेस से सपा की नाराजगी की क्या है वजह?
description: उत्तर प्रदेश विधानसभा चुनाव से पहले समाजवादी पार्टी और कांग्रेस के बीच सीट बंटवारे को लेकर विवाद गहरा गया है. गांधी परिवार के गढ़ अमेठी और रायबरेली में सिर्फ एक सीट देने पर कांग्रेस में नाराजगी है.
author: आशुतोष प्रताप सिंह
content:
'गांधी परिवार के गढ़ में सिर्फ एक सीट...', कांग्रेस से सपा की नाराजगी की क्या है वजह?
उत्तर प्रदेश विधानसभा चुनाव से पहले समाजवादी पार्टी और कांग्रेस के बीच सीट बंटवारे को लेकर विवाद गहरा गया है. गांधी परिवार के गढ़ अमेठी और रायबरेली में सिर्फ एक सीट देने पर कांग्रेस में नाराजगी है.
उत्तर प्रदेश विधानसभा चुनाव से पहले समाजवादी पार्टी (सपा) और कांग्रेस के बीच सीटों के बंटवारे को लेकर टकराव बढ़ता नजर आ रहा है. कांग्रेस ने पहले विधानसभा चुनाव में 131 सीटों पर चुनाव लड़ने की मांग रखी थी, लेकिन सपा प्रमुख अखिलेश यादव ने इसके जवाब में कांग्रेस को सिर्फ 26 सीटें देने का प्रस्ताव रखा.
इंडियन एक्सप्रेस की रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, सबसे ज्यादा नाराजगी अमेठी और रायबरेली को लेकर है. गांधी परिवार के इन पारंपरिक गढ़ों में कांग्रेस सभी विधानसभा सीटों पर चुनाव लड़ना चाहती है, जबकि सपा ने अपनी सूची में दोनों क्षेत्रों को मिलाकर केवल एक सीट देने की पेशकश की है. मंगलवार को दोनों दलों के बीच हुई बातचीत में कांग्रेस ने अपनी मांग घटाकर 120 सीटें कर दी, लेकिन सहमति नहीं बन सकी.
सपा ने सीटों के लिए तय किया अलग फॉर्मूला
सपा के सूत्रों का कहना है कि कांग्रेस की ओर से सीटों की मांग के पीछे कोई स्पष्ट आधार नहीं बताया जा रहा है. सोमवार को हुई बैठक में भी कांग्रेस नेताओं से 131 सीटें मांगने का फॉर्मूला पूछा गया था. कांग्रेस ने करीब 30 सीटों के लिए तर्क दिया कि 2024 के लोकसभा चुनाव में इन क्षेत्रों में पार्टी आगे रही थी, लेकिन बाकी 90 सीटों के लिए कोई ठोस आधार नहीं दिया गया.
सपा ने कांग्रेस को 26 सीटें देने के लिए 2022 के विधानसभा चुनाव के नतीजों को आधार बनाया है. इनमें चार सीटें ऐसी हैं, जहां कांग्रेस दूसरे स्थान पर रही थी, जबकि दो सीटों पर उसने जीत दर्ज की थी. इसके अलावा पार्टी को 20 अन्य सीटों का प्रस्ताव दिया गया है.
इन 26 सीटों पर कांग्रेस को मिला प्रस्ताव
कांग्रेस ने 2022 में रामपुर खास और फरेंदा सीटें जीती थीं. इसके अलावा मथुरा, खेरागढ़ (आगरा), जगदीशपुर (अमेठी) और किदवई नगर (कानपुर) में पार्टी दूसरे स्थान पर रही थी.
सपा की ओर से प्रस्तावित अन्य 20 सीटों में बागपत, मोदीनगर (गाजियाबाद), हापुड़, जेवर (गौतमबुद्ध नगर), स्याना और खुर्जा (बुलंदशहर), खैर (अलीगढ़), इगलास (हाथरस), मांट (मथुरा), आगरा उत्तर, फतेहपुर सीकरी (आगरा), बिलग्राम-मल्लावां (हरदोई), गोविंद नगर (कानपुर), नानपारा (बहराइच), गोरखपुर शहर, खजनी (संतकबीर नगर), पडरौना और फाजिलनगर (कुशीनगर), पिंडरा और वाराणसी कैंट शामिल हैं.
इन सीटों का क्षेत्रवार बंटवारा देखें तो 11 पश्चिमी उत्तर प्रदेश, दो मध्य उत्तर प्रदेश और सात पूर्वी उत्तर प्रदेश की हैं. सपा संगठन के लिहाज से पश्चिमी उत्तर प्रदेश में खुद को अपेक्षाकृत कमजोर मानती है.
कांग्रेस नेताओं ने जताई नाराजगी
सपा की ओर से 26 सीटों की सूची मिलने के बाद कांग्रेस नेताओं ने कड़ी नाराजगी जताई. सीट बंटवारे की बातचीत में शामिल एक वरिष्ठ कांग्रेस नेता ने कहा कि अमेठी और रायबरेली में पार्टी को केवल एक सीट देने का प्रस्ताव समझ से परे है. उन्होंने सवाल उठाया कि 403 विधानसभा सीटों वाले प्रदेश में कांग्रेस को सिर्फ 26 सीटें कैसे दी जा सकती हैं. नेता ने यह भी कहा कि लोकसभा चुनाव में कांग्रेस ने 80 में से 17 सीटों पर चुनाव लड़ा था और इस मामले में पार्टी बैठक के बाद अपना औपचारिक पक्ष रखेगी.
अखिल भारतीय कांग्रेस कमेटी के सूत्रों के मुताबिक, मंगलवार को सांसद प्रमोद तिवारी के आवास पर हुई बैठक में दोनों दलों के नेताओं के बीच तीखी बहस भी हुई.
2022 के नतीजों को बनाया सीटों का आधार
सपा की ओर से पश्चिमी उत्तर प्रदेश की जिन 11 सीटों का प्रस्ताव दिया गया है, उन सभी पर 2022 में भाजपा ने जीत दर्ज की थी. उस समय अखिलेश यादव की सहयोगी रही जयंत चौधरी की राष्ट्रीय लोकदल (रालोद) इनमें से सात सीटों पर दूसरे स्थान पर थी. दो सीटों पर बसपा और दो पर सपा दूसरे नंबर पर रही थी.
मध्य उत्तर प्रदेश की दो सीटों में बिलग्राम-मल्लावां में सपा दूसरे स्थान पर रही थी, जबकि गोविंद नगर में उसे 80,896 वोटों के बड़े अंतर से हार मिली थी.
पूर्वी उत्तर प्रदेश की सभी सात सीटों पर 2022 में सपा दूसरे स्थान पर रही थी. इन सभी सीटों पर एनडीए ने जीत दर्ज की थी. इनमें छह सीटें भाजपा और एक सीट नानपारा अपना दल (सोनेलाल) के खाते में गई थी. प्रस्तावित सीटों में मुख्यमंत्री योगी आदित्यनाथ की गोरखपुर शहर विधानसभा सीट भी शामिल है.

title: '16 दिसंबर तक बांग्लादेश ले लेंगे हमलोग, बहुत हो गया', बंगाल के मंत्री को आया गुस्सा
description: बंगाल के राज्य मंत्री अर्जुन सिंह ने बांग्लादेश को लेकर बड़ा बयान दिया है. उन्होंने कहा है कि 16 दिसंबर तक बांग्लादेश पर कब्जा कर लेंगे. हम उनसे बदला जरूर लेंगे.
author: दीक्षा छाबड़ा
content:
'16 दिसंबर तक बांग्लादेश ले लेंगे हमलोग, बहुत हो गया', बंगाल के मंत्री को आया गुस्सा
बंगाल के राज्य मंत्री अर्जुन सिंह ने बांग्लादेश को लेकर बड़ा बयान दिया है. उन्होंने कहा है कि 16 दिसंबर तक बांग्लादेश पर कब्जा कर लेंगे. हम उनसे बदला जरूर लेंगे.
बंगाल के मंत्री अर्जुन सिंह एक बार फिर अपने बयान को लेकर चर्चा में आ गए हैं. उन्होंने बांग्लादेश को लेकर एक अजीबो-गरीब बयान दिया है. उन्होंने बांग्लादेश में हिंदुओं की हत्या का मुद्दा उठाते हुए कहा है कि 16 दिसंबर तक देश पर कब्जा कर लिया जाएगा. उनका ये बयान वायरल हो गया है.
अर्जुन सिंह 24 नवंबर को भाटपाड़ा में पूर्णिमा के अवसर पर आयोजित गंगा आरती के कार्यक्रम में शामिल होने के लिए गए थे. जहां पर उनसे बांग्लादेश में हिंदुओं पर हो रहे हमले को लेकर सवाल पूछा गया.

16 दिसंबर तक कर लेंगे कब्जा
अर्जुन सिंह ने अपने बयान में कहा, 16 दिसंबर तक हम बांग्लादेश पर कब्जा कर लेंगे. बांग्लादेश में जिस तरह से हिंदुओं की हत्या की गई है. हम उसका बदला जरूर लेंगे. इसके बारे में कोई संदेह नहीं है.
16 दिसंबर क्यों है खास
16 दिसंबर का बांग्लादेश में बड़ा महत्व है. 16 दिसंबर के ही दिन 1971 में पाकिस्तान को हराकर पूर्वी पाकिस्तान आज का बांग्लादेश बना था. 16 दिसंबर 1971 और उसी दिन से बांग्लादेश में इस तारीख पर विजय दिवस या बांग्लादेश मुक्ति दिवस मनाया जाता है.
बता दें 16 दिसंबर को बांग्लादेश की अपदस्थ पूर्व प्रधानमंत्री शेख हसीना ने भारत से अपने देश वापस जाने का ऐलान किया है. शेख हसीना भारत में दो साल से अधिक निर्वासन के बाद अपने देश जाने वाली हैं. 24 नवंबर को इसकी जानकारी दी गई है.
शेख हसीना के प्रवक्ता सैयद मुजम्मिल अली ने कहा, 5 अगस्त 2024 को शेख हसीना को बांग्लादेश के एक विमान से भारत लाया गया था, इसलिए अब वह सरकार से मांग कर रही हैं कि उनके लिए दिल्ली से वापस ढाका जाने के लिए हवाई यात्रा का इंतजाम किया जाए. ऐसी परिस्थितियों में संविधान के विपरीत उन्हें देश से बाहर निकालने के बाद अब सरकार की यह जिम्मेदारी है कि वह 16 दिसंबर को 'विजय दिवस' के मौके पर उनकी बांग्लादेश वापसी को संभव बनाए.'

title: कार्तिगई दीपम विवाद: CM विजय पर गठबंधन के दलों का दबाव? BJP-VHP भड़की
description: तमिलनाडु में सुप्रीम कोर्ट की अनुमति के बावजूद तिरुपरनकुंद्रम पहाड़ी के दीपाथून पर दीप नहीं जलाया गया. इसको लेकर BJP-VHP ने विजय सरकार पर सवाल खड़े किए हैं.
author: सौरव कुमार
content:
कार्तिगई दीपम विवाद: CM विजय पर गठबंधन के दलों का दबाव? BJP-VHP भड़की
तमिलनाडु में सुप्रीम कोर्ट की अनुमति के बावजूद तिरुपरनकुंद्रम पहाड़ी के दीपाथून पर दीप नहीं जलाया गया. इसको लेकर BJP-VHP ने विजय सरकार पर सवाल खड़े किए हैं.
तमिलनाडु के मदुरै जिले की तिरुप्परनकुंद्रम पहाड़ी पर स्थित दीपाथून पर पारंपरिक कार्तिगई दीपम नहीं जलाया गया. तमिलनाडु में विजय की सरकार ने सुप्रीम कोर्ट के फैसले को नजर अंदाज करते हुए तिरुप्परनकुंद्रम पहाड़ी के खंभे पर दीपक न जलाकर उची पिल्लयार मंदिर के पास दीपक जलाने का फैसला किया. इसको लेकर BJP-VHP ने विजय सरकार पर तीखा हमला बोला है. उन्होंने कहा कि सुप्रीम कोर्ट के तरफ से जारी आदेश को भी TVK सरकार ने नजर अंदाज कर दिया. हालांकि, इस बीच ऐसी अटकलें लगाई जा रही है कि अगर दीपाथून पर कार्तिगई दीपम पर दीपक जलाया जाता तो विजय को नुकसान हो सकता था.
तमिलनाडु में TVK को इंडियन यूनियन मुस्लिम लीग (IUML), विदुथलाई चिरुथैगल काची (VCK), CPI, CPI(M) और कांग्रेस समर्थन देती है. इन पार्टियों ने विवादित जगह पर दूसरा दीपक जलाने का कड़ा विरोध किया था.
BJP के प्रदेश अध्यक्ष का बयान
दीपाथून पर पारंपरिक कार्तिगई दीपम ने जलाने के मामले पर BJP के प्रदेश अध्यक्ष नैनार नागेंद्रन ने बताया कि मद्रास हाई कोर्ट ने मामले पर हस्तक्षेप किया. उन्होंने हिरासत में लिए गए लोगों को तुरंत रिहा करने करने और कलेक्टर-पुलिस अधिकारियों को सुप्रीम कोर्ट के फैसले को लागू करने का निर्देश दिया था. इसके बावजूद पिल्लयार मंदिर में दीपक जला दिया गया. VHP ने मंगलवार को तमिलनाडु सरकार पर आरोप लगाया कि उसने मदुरै के पास तिरुप्परनकुंद्रम में कार्तिगई दीपम जलाने के मामले में खुद को सुप्रीम कोर्ट के आदेश से ऊपर मान लिया है.
VHP के राष्ट्रीय प्रवक्ता विनोद बंसल का बयान
VHP ने कहा कि इन घटनाओं से कानून के शासन और न्यायपालिका की गरिमा पर गंभीर सवाल खड़े होते हैं. VHP के राष्ट्रीय प्रवक्ता विनोद बंसल ने X पर एक पोस्ट में कहा, "आज तमिलनाडु में जो हुआ, मुझे उसी बात का डर था. उन्होंने सुप्रीम कोर्ट के आदेश के ऊपर अपनी सर्वोच्चता थोप दी है." तमिलनाडु सरकार ने मंगलवार को विवादित स्तंभ पर एक बार के लिए कार्तिगई दीपम जलाने के सुप्रीम कोर्ट के आदेश की अवहेलना की. इस घटना ने एक बड़े कानूनी और राजनीतिक विवाद को जन्म दे दिया है, जिसके चलते बीजेपी और हिंदू संगठनों ने विरोध प्रदर्शन शुरू कर दिए हैं.
बंसल ने आरोप लगाया कि सुप्रीम कोर्ट की तरफ से मंगलवार को एक बार के लिए यह अनुष्ठान करने की अनुमति दिए जाने के बावजूद, स्थानीय प्रशासन ने तिरुप्परनकुंद्रम पहाड़ी पर स्थित विवादित पत्थर के स्तंभ दीपाथून पर दीपक जलाने की सदियों पुरानी परंपरा को पूरा नहीं होने दिया.

description: उत्तर प्रदेश की 403 विधानसभा सीटों पर 2027 में चुनाव होना है. बीजेपी को चुनौती देने के लिए 2024 के लोकसभा चुनाव में साथ आए सपा और कांग्रेस के सामने अब विधानसभा चुनाव का गणित है.
author: संकल्प ठाकुर
content:
Explained: कांग्रेस के 130 सीटों की मांग बनाम सपा का 26 सीटों का प्रस्ताव, क्यों नहीं बन रही सहमति? कहां मतभेद
उत्तर प्रदेश की 403 विधानसभा सीटों पर 2027 में चुनाव होना है. बीजेपी को चुनौती देने के लिए 2024 के लोकसभा चुनाव में साथ आए सपा और कांग्रेस के सामने अब विधानसभा चुनाव का गणित है.
उत्तर प्रदेश विधानसभा चुनाव 2027 से पहले समाजवादी पार्टी और कांग्रेस के गठबंधन में सीटों का बंटवारा सबसे बड़ी चुनौती बन गया है. कांग्रेस करीब 130 सीटों पर दावा कर रही है, जबकि अखिलेश यादव की पार्टी ने शुरुआती बातचीत में सिर्फ 26 सीटों का प्रस्ताव रखा. दोनों दल साथ चुनाव लड़ने की बात कह रहे हैं, लेकिन सवाल है कि कांग्रेस की मांग और सपा की पेशकश के बीच इतनी बड़ी दूरी कैसे खत्म होगी?
उत्तर प्रदेश की 403 विधानसभा सीटों पर 2027 में चुनाव होना है. बीजेपी को चुनौती देने के लिए 2024 के लोकसभा चुनाव में साथ आए सपा और कांग्रेस के सामने अब विधानसभा चुनाव का गणित है. लोकसभा में दोनों दलों का गठबंधन सफल रहा था, लेकिन विधानसभा चुनाव में सीटों का बंटवारा ज्यादा पेचीदा है. 24 नवंबर को हुई दूसरे दौर की बातचीत के बाद भी कोई अंतिम सहमति नहीं बन सकी. कांग्रेस ने 130 सीटों की सूची दी, जबकि सपा ने 26 सीटों का प्रस्ताव रखा.
आइए समझते हैं कहां मामला फंस रहा है
130 सीटों की मांग बनाम 26 सीटों का प्रस्ताव
गठबंधन में सबसे बड़ा पेंच सीटों की संख्या है. कांग्रेस का शुरुआती दावा इससे भी बड़ा था. अक्टूबर में पार्टी ने 175 से 200 सीटों की सूची तैयार करने की बात कही थी. बाद में बातचीत के दौरान यह मांग घटकर पहले 130 सीटों तक आई. हालांकि सपा ने 26 सीटों का शुरुआती प्रस्ताव रखा है और संकेत दिया है कि संख्या बढ़ सकती है, लेकिन 50 से ऊपर जाना मुश्किल होगा.
यानी दोनों दलों के बीच अभी भी करीब 70 से 90 सीटों का फासला है. कांग्रेस इसे गठबंधन में सम्मानजनक हिस्सेदारी का सवाल मान रही है, जबकि सपा का तर्क है कि सीटें संख्या के आधार पर नहीं, जीतने की संभावना के आधार पर तय होनी चाहिए.
2024 के लोकसभा चुनाव का प्रदर्शन बनाम 2022 का विधानसभा रिकॉर्ड
कांग्रेस अपनी बड़ी मांग के पीछे 2024 के लोकसभा चुनाव का प्रदर्शन रख रही है. उस चुनाव में सपा ने उत्तर प्रदेश की 80 में से 37 सीटें जीती थीं, जबकि कांग्रेस को छह सीटों पर जीत मिली थी. कांग्रेस का मानना है कि लोकसभा चुनाव में उसके प्रदर्शन और राहुल गांधी-प्रियंका गांधी की सक्रियता ने पार्टी की राजनीतिक स्थिति मजबूत की है. इसलिए उसे विधानसभा चुनाव में भी बड़ा हिस्सा मिलना चाहिए.
लेकिन सपा 2022 के विधानसभा चुनाव का रिकॉर्ड सामने रख रही है. उस चुनाव में कांग्रेस को 403 में से सिर्फ दो सीटें मिली थीं, जबकि सपा ने 111 सीटें जीती थीं. सपा का तर्क है कि लोकसभा चुनाव का वोट विधानसभा सीटों पर सीधे लागू नहीं किया जा सकता. विधानसभा चुनाव में स्थानीय संगठन, उम्मीदवार और बूथ स्तर की ताकत ज्यादा मायने रखती है.
यही दोनों दलों के बीच मूल राजनीतिक मतभेद है. कांग्रेस अपनी हालिया वापसी का हिस्सा मांग रही है, जबकि सपा पुराने विधानसभा प्रदर्शन और जमीनी ताकत को आधार बना रही है.
अमेठी-रायबरेली पर कांग्रेस का दावा, सपा का अपना चुनावी आकलन
कांग्रेस की मांग सिर्फ सीटों की संख्या तक सीमित नहीं है. वह उन इलाकों में भी मजबूत हिस्सेदारी चाहती है, जिन्हें वह अपना पारंपरिक राजनीतिक क्षेत्र मानती है. इनमें सबसे अहम अमेठी और रायबरेली हैं. कांग्रेस इन दोनों जिलों की विधानसभा सीटों पर बड़ा दावा कर रही है. उसकी दलील है कि गांधी परिवार से जुड़े इन क्षेत्रों में पार्टी का ऐतिहासिक आधार और 2024 के लोकसभा चुनाव का प्रदर्शन उसके पक्ष में है.
लेकिन सपा इन सीटों को केवल कांग्रेस की पारंपरिक पहचान के आधार पर छोड़ने के पक्ष में नहीं दिखती. पार्टी ने इन क्षेत्रों में अपने स्तर पर सर्वे भी कराए हैं, ताकि यह समझा जा सके कि वहां कांग्रेस की वास्तविक चुनावी ताकत कितनी है. सपा का आकलन है कि गठबंधन में सीटें किसी पुराने राजनीतिक दावे के बजाय मौजूदा जीत की संभावना से तय होनी चाहिए.
यही वजह है कि अमेठी-रायबरेली का मामला दोनों दलों के लिए प्रतिष्ठा का सवाल बन सकता है.
पश्चिमी यूपी से पूर्वांचल तक कांग्रेस की हिस्सेदारी, लेकिन सपा की सूची अलग
क्षेत्रीय दावों को देखें तो कांग्रेस लगभग हर जिले में अपनी मौजूदगी चाहती है. उसकी मांग है कि इटावा और मैनपुरी जैसे सपा के मजबूत गढ़ों को छोड़कर उसे लगभग हर जिले में कम से कम एक विधानसभा सीट मिले. इससे पार्टी को सिर्फ चुनाव लड़ने का मौका नहीं मिलेगा, बल्कि संगठन को भी विस्तार मिलेगा.
सपा ने इसके जवाब में 26 सीटों की अपनी प्राथमिक सूची दी है. इसमें क्षेत्रवार स्थिति इस तरह है:
इसके अलावा कांग्रेस की 2022 में जीतीं रामपुर खास और फरेंदा सीटें और उन चार सीटों को भी सूची में रखा गया है, जहां पार्टी दूसरे स्थान पर रही थी. ये सीटें मथुरा, खेरागढ़, जगदीशपुर और किदवई नगर की हैं.
यहीं एक बड़ा अंतर है. कांग्रेस का जोर व्यापक भौगोलिक मौजूदगी पर है, जबकि सपा की सूची 2022 के विधानसभा चुनाव में कांग्रेस के प्रदर्शन को आधार बनाकर तैयार की गई है. कांग्रेस की मांग है कि उसे सिर्फ कुछ चुनिंदा सीटों तक सीमित न किया जाए. सपा चाहती है कि हर सीट पर उम्मीदवार की जीतने की क्षमता देखी जाए.
उम्मीदवारों के नाम, सीटों पर दोहरा दावा और भरोसे की कमी
विवाद सिर्फ सीटों का नहीं, उम्मीदवारों के चयन का भी है. सपा ने कांग्रेस से उन सीटों के संभावित उम्मीदवारों के नाम मांगे हैं, जिन पर वह दावा कर रही है. साथ ही जातीय समीकरण और चुनावी गणित का ब्योरा भी मांगा गया है. कांग्रेस इस स्तर पर अपने उम्मीदवारों की सूची साझा करने को लेकर सहज नहीं दिखी.
इस बीच सीटों पर दावेदारी का टकराव भी सामने आया. 25 नवंबर को सपा ने बेहट, सहारनपुर, शामली, अमरोहा और ललितपुर की सीटों पर उम्मीदवार घोषित किए. NDTV की रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, इनमें बेहट और सहारनपुर कांग्रेस की इच्छा सूची में भी थे. इससे गठबंधन की बातचीत के बीच दोनों दलों के बीच असहजता बढ़ी. कांग्रेस खेमे में सहारनपुर से सपा उम्मीदवार के खिलाफ अपना प्रत्याशी उतारने की चर्चा भी सामने आई है. हालांकि इसे अभी अंतिम फैसला नहीं माना जा सकता.
सपा की दलील है कि 2022 में कांग्रेस को सिर्फ दो सीटों पर जीत मिली और उसका वोट शेयर 2.33 प्रतिशत था. कांग्रेस का जवाब है कि 2024 में उसने गठबंधन के साथ छह लोकसभा सीटें जीतीं और उसका वोट शेयर 9.46 प्रतिशत रहा. कांग्रेस का मानना है कि वह दलित, ब्राह्मण और अति पिछड़े वर्ग के मतदाताओं को गठबंधन के साथ जोड़ सकती है. यानी सपा कांग्रेस की मौजूदा ताकत पर सवाल उठा रही है, जबकि कांग्रेस अपने बढ़े हुए राजनीतिक प्रभाव के मुताबिक हिस्सेदारी चाहती है.
गठबंधन टूटेगा या बीच का रास्ता निकलेगा?
24 नवंबर तक दोनों दलों के बीच बातचीत पूरी तरह टूटी नहीं है. अखिलेश यादव ने कांग्रेस को खुला संदेश देते हुए कहा है कि सीटों का बंटवारा 'हम बनाम तुम' के आधार पर नहीं, बल्कि जीत की संभावना के आधार पर होना चाहिए. उन्होंने 26 प्राथमिक सीटों के अलावा कांग्रेस से अन्य संभावित सीटों की सूची भी मांगी है. दोनों दलों के उम्मीदवारों और चुनावी समीकरणों का संयुक्त आकलन करने का प्रस्ताव भी रखा है.
इससे तीन संभावनाएं बनती हैं
बीच का सीट फॉर्मूला: कांग्रेस अपनी 100 से अधिक सीटों की मांग से नीचे आए और सपा 26 से आगे बढ़कर कोई बड़ा प्रस्ताव दे. 75-80 सीटों पर समझौते की संभावना पहले रिपोर्ट की गई थी, लेकिन इसे दोनों दलों का अंतिम सहमत फॉर्मूला नहीं माना जा सकता.
सीट एडजस्टमेंट का रास्ता: जिन सीटों पर दोनों दल दावा कर रहे हैं, वहां दोनों उम्मीदवारों का सर्वे और जातीय समीकरण देखकर एक साझा उम्मीदवार तय किया जाए. अखिलेश इसी मॉडल की बात कर रहे हैं.
कुछ सीटों पर दोस्ताना मुकाबला: अगर सहमति नहीं बनती तो कुछ सीटों पर दोनों दल अलग-अलग उम्मीदवार उतार सकते हैं. इससे विपक्षी वोटों के बंटने का खतरा रहेगा और बीजेपी को फायदा मिल सकता है.
सपा-कांग्रेस के बीच असली लड़ाई सिर्फ 26 और 100 से अधिक सीटों की नहीं है. यह तय करने की लड़ाई है कि 2027 के यूपी चुनाव में गठबंधन का नेतृत्व और चुनावी रणनीति किसके आकलन से चलेगी. कांग्रेस 2024 के प्रदर्शन को अपनी वापसी का प्रमाण मान रही है, जबकि अखिलेश यादव 2022 के विधानसभा नतीजों और मौजूदा क्षेत्रीय ताकत को आधार बना रहे हैं. अगर दोनों दल अपनी-अपनी राजनीतिक हैसियत के दावे से आगे नहीं बढ़े, तो गठबंधन की एकजुटता पर सवाल उठेंगे. और अगर सीटों के बजाय जीतने की संभावना को साझा आधार बनाया गया, तो समझौते का रास्ता निकल सकता है.
